output.reason: A 52-year-old with hot flashes, night sweats and irregular periods requests discussion of treatment options, which needs clinician assessment of history and risks before hormonal or non-hormonal therapy, but reports nothing time-critical.
output.patientMessage: I've asked our Counsel clinician to review this in the thread to discuss your options, since choosing between hormonal and non-hormonal treatment depends on your medical history and preferences. Meanwhile, layered clothing, a cool bedroom, and limiting alcohol, caffeine and spicy foods may help. Contact a clinician promptly if you develop very heavy or prolonged bleeding, bleeding after 12 months without periods, or severe pain.
